dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped high-contrast structures are visible along the mid-to-upper dorsal region. The perimeters exhibit a jagged, high-frequency edge where dark-charcoal pixels transition sharply to light-gray interior rings, often surrounding a dark central void.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated in the anterior-dorsal transition area. These clusters lack an internal gradient and appear as irregular, solid light-toned aggregates against the dark base fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triangular geometric relationship is formed by the centroids of three prominent macro-annuli situated along the upper dorsal ridge. An auxiliary chain of keypoints from smaller blobs follows the lateral-posterior curvature, forming a descending arc.
